raw_response: The figure presents a clustered bar chart illustrating the percentage of the BIP (Gross Domestic Product) over time, from 1991 to 2023. The horizontal axis represents the years, ranging from 1991 to 2023, with tick marks indicating each year. The vertical axis represents the percentage of the BIP, ranging from -0.5% to 3.5%, with tick marks spaced approximately every 0.5%. The horizontal axis displays three data series: “Bund” (blue), “Länder” (light green), and “Gemeinden” (dark green). The “Bund” series is represented by a solid blue bar, which fluctuates between approximately 1.5% and 2.5% throughout the period. The “Länder” series is represented by a light green bar, which also fluctuates between approximately 1.5% and 2.5% and closely mirrors the “Bund” series. The “Gemeinden” series is represented by a dark green bar, which fluctuates between approximately 0.5% and 2.0% and is generally lower than the other two series. Overlaying the bars is a gray shaded line representing “Gebietskörperschancen insgesamt” (total territorial opportunities), which fluctuates between approximately -0.5% and 2.5%. The bars are arranged in a clustered fashion, with each year represented by a single bar for each data series. The data series are not sorted in any particular order.
